instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Switch one of my show-rule presets on or off", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:switch-a-kept-show-type and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Switches a type you keep on or off (use: { type, on }); only types you keep can be on, and a type applies only while it is on.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: @own-records (workspace:read); show-type-use (records:list, records:read).
